text: dsh-perfscope 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件健康检查工具，可从宿主命令或 CLI 扫描插件挂载、配置和会话运行指标，并按硬健康、运行健康与治理维度评分。它生成 Markdown 或 HTML 报告，列出问题和插件明细；CLI 还可将指定插件写入 profile patch 以禁用，并提供撤销操作。Web 客户端提供侧栏健康检查按钮。适合维护 DSH 插件配置的用户。需要本机 DSH 环境；默认本地扫描无需 API key，registry 查询可选。

dsh-perfscope checks DSH plugins from a host command or CLI, scoring mounts, configuration and session metrics. It exports reports as Markdown, HTML or JSON. CLI can disable and restore plugins through profile patches; a web sidebar button starts scans. Local DSH required; registry lookup optional.

需要把插件健康结果导出成 Markdown 或 HTML 报告。

I want to find plugins that failed to mount in my DSH setup.

Show me runtime error rates and latency from recent sessions.
Can I disable a broken plugin and undo the change later?
插件健康扫描：读取 DSH 插件清单、profile patch 和最近会话指标，识别挂载、配置及运行问题。可从 /perfscope 命令或 CLI scan 触发。
评分与报告：按硬健康、运行健康和治理维度汇总问题，输出总分及插件明细；CLI 支持 Markdown、HTML 和 JSON 格式。
禁用与撤销：CLI fix 可将指定插件写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml，并记录变更前内容；undo 恢复上次记录的文件内容。
侧栏快捷检查：Web 客户端在侧栏底部操作区加入健康检查按钮，点击后通过宿主命令运行当前会话的 /perfscope。
dsh-perfscope 使用前须知：启用 registry 选项时会向 registry.npmjs.org 查询插件包的最近发布时间；默认关闭。 (见 src/scanner/registry.ts:13-18)
dsh-perfscope README · Introduction：<div align="center">

dsh-perfscope README · ⚡ dsh-perfscope：**PerfScope for DeepSeek Harness — one-click health check & score for your installed plugins.** Scan → Score → Fix → Share, all local. Is your Harness healthy? Find out in one click. [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-perfscope) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/Evhye38496/dsh-perfscope) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-perfscope` *(listing in the dsh-market registry pending — see Project plan)* ---

dsh-perfscope README · Why：DeepSeek Harness is young, and its plugin ecosystem is exploding — thousands of plugins, skins, tools, and presets appear weekly. After you install a few dozen, questions show up fast:

- **Which plugin is actually broken or silently failing?**
- **Which ones slow down every session or eat tokens?**
- **Am I running duplicates, conflicts, or stale plugins I forgot about?**
- **Is my setup trustworthy — or a pile of random tags?**

dsh-perfscope README · Why：The ecosystem has no "health check" yet. **dsh-perfscope** fills that gap: one click gives you a **0–100 health score**, a plain-language issue list, and safe one-click fixes you can undo anytime.

> This is the same methodology that powers our VS Code tool, **PerfScope** — adapted to the agent-harness world, where every run is traceable and runtime data is richer than any IDE.
dsh-perfscope README · What it checks：Health score = three dimensions, weighted configurable (default `0.6 / 0.25 / 0.15`):

dsh-perfscope README · What it checks：| Dimension | Question | Examples of signals |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Hard health** | Can it actually be used? | mount failures, unmet dependencies, core version conflicts, invalid config, incompatibility with your dsh RC |
| **Runtime health** | Is it fast and stable? | tool error/timeout rates, average latency vs. baseline, token / context share |
| **Governance health** | Is it tidy and trustworthy? | overlapping capabilities, stale plugins, sources outside curated registries |
dsh-perfscope README · What it checks：Severity grading `critical / warning / suggestion` — every finding is one sentence a human can act on.

dsh-perfscope README · Safety first：- Reads your plugin tree and session/telemetry stats **locally**. Nothing ever leaves your machine by default.
- Fixes only write patch rows to `cordis.patch.yml` (`- id: …` + `disabled: true`, the official patch layer) — **never** uninstalls, deletes, or edits source.
- Every write is **previewed first**, recorded in the **Doctor Change Log**, and **reversible with one click**.
- Host-critical plugins and hand-edited patch rows are protected from one-click toggles.

dsh-perfscope README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-perfscope
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Settings → dsh-perfscope**.

Prerequisites: Node `^22.19.0` or `24+`. Targets dsh `0.1.0-rc.8` (pinned post-SPIKE; preview moves fast — see roadmap).

dsh-perfscope README · Usage：**Web UI** — Settings → dsh-perfscope: run a full check, read your score card, apply safe fixes with preview, undo any fix, export a report. (v1.0)

**Headless / CI** — scan the real host, fix, undo:

```bash
dsh-perfscope README · scan the live dsh profile (read-only; no model key needed)：npx dsh-perfscope scan --profile web --format markdown --out report.md
